extras.real_size: 1990s two-seat sports coupe, approx. 4.4 x 1.9 x 1.2 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.62 m
extras.notes: generic, brand-free 1990s sports car: low rounded wedge, slim clear-glass headlights, large front air intake, side air intakes, rear wing on two posts, full-width tail light band, twin chrome exhausts; front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, two seats and steering wheel; blank number plates, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
